The '''H'kig book of laws''' was a publication that purported to deal with the laws of the [[H'kig]],<ref name="SOL" /> a reclusive religious order.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|46|The H'Kig}}</ref> Between [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> after a visit to a small shop called the [[Galactic Archives]] in [[Trader's Plaza]], [[Talos City|Talos]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] while searching for information about<ref name="SOL" /> his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|mother]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] boarded a [[Air taxi/Legends|courtesy cab]] operated by the shop to shuttle him to their central distribution hub. In the vehicle, Skywalker saw an advertisement for the H'kig book of laws alongside others for ''[[Principles of Power]]'', the [[Sith book of offerings and rituals]], and a [[The secrets of forming Bilar-type claqa group-minds|publication]] that claimed to hold the secrets of forming [[Hive mind/Legends|group minds]] like the [[Bilar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Although the shop promised a discount for the purchase of three or more volumes, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] surmised that the books were frauds.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The H'kig book of laws is mentioned in ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', the second novel of ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' trilogy. The novel was written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] and published in [[1996]].<ref name="SOL" />
